title: OpenFASoC temperature sensor & digital LDO
tagline: Turning circuit specifications into open-source silicon.
description: Open-source generators turn circuit specifications into physical designs. The temperature-sensor study explores 64 fabricated instances in SkyWater 130 nm; the LDO work extends autonomous generation to power regulation.

publications.title: An Open-Source and Autonomous Temperature Sensor Generator Verified With 64 Instances in SkyWater 130 nm for Comprehensive Design Space Exploration
An Open Source Compatible Framework to Fully Autonomous Digital LDO Generation
publications.venue: IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS)
